purpose: NP.X3's readings and NP-6: the WIA team's delegated review (R55, D12) of the three packs on production. The blind reading preferred the pack copy on 16 of 16 pairs but found it less faithful in one clause of two pieces, and one clause of brief 1's written stance Reel says a planned review happened. Section 7.3's rule would ship briefs 1 and 2 in missing_only, losing eight preferred pieces to two clauses; under D12 the team edits those clauses instead, so no shipped piece is less faithful than the brief. Briefs 1 and 2 on production replayed the proof byte for byte, so the same three edits apply. Brief 3 on production was finished again live under v2 (the proof's v2 answers were saved under the edited wire schema, PR #18); its pack has no open finding, and the agent's reading found one certainty its check let through ('Only the client's team could explain'), the line scratch copy B's check repaired, so the team edits it. Style suggestions from the reading are left for WIA. (On scratch copy B the fourth step attested the open finding of copy B's own v2 pack: review-copyB.json.)
